reviews.x: this is nothing but a cut piece of stretch material.  It could be purchased in a cloth store for $1 per yard.  No way is this worth $22

I loved it. I will be ordering more colors. I am transitioning to natural and this was perfect while wearing my protective style. The material is soft and a little stretchy which helps me manipulate it into different styles. I highly recommend!

reviews.t: Very poor quality for the price!
reviews.x: I have lots of head wraps and I have paid plenty of money for many of them. This head wrap however is the worst one I have ever purchased. The material is thin and doesn't give much stretch. It is more suitable for an under scarf ( which is what I currently use if for) or wrapping your hair at night than wearing out alone. I am very disappointed in this product and the quality, it reminds me of the night caps/scarves you buy in plastic packages from the drugstore for 4 or 5 dollars to sleep in.
There's no way this is worth  $22 will be returning

I am absolutely impressed with his headwrap! I ordered the black headwrap and I couldn't be more happy. I have bought other black headwraps and it just never worked out. They were either not big enough, or too stretchy, or too slippery where it keeps coming unraveled. But this one is perfect. Just the right length and has the right amount of stretch and hold. I was so surprised to got so many compliments on just a plain black headwrap. It is my go to head piece when I just want to tuck my hair a

I love this. Love it. It's long, and stretchy. And PLAIN. I can't wear a boldly patterned or sometimes even a solid colored head scarf with school or work. It depends on my professor. It's also a personal preference at times, just wanting to wear a simple color like black. I have dreads that have partially locked but they also look crazy as they frizz up between washes and I like to cover it with this. New to the head wrap world I need the stretch this provides-I don't know how to do fashionista
Love them all I wear in the fall and winter.

reviews.t: Should have just went to a fabric store
reviews.x: It is a long piece of black material that i paid  $29for. Not even any instructions on how to wrap. I probably would not feel so bad had there been ideas about how to wrap. Live and learn.

Love the stretch. Eliminates need to know how to wrap. Just take both ends, wrap around then tuck. Or tie for an elegant look. Price is high but if the material lasts through months of daily use its well worth it.

reviews.t: Cost is too high for a fabric that beads up quickly.
reviews.x: For the cost of this headwrap I would have expected it to not "bead up" so quickly. I did like it when I received it, but I can go to a fabric store and purchase $22 worth of fabric and end up with several headwraps in different colors and have a better lasting fabric at that!!...A little disappointed for the price.

reviews.t: This wrap is absolutely perfect! While working through out the day it never ...
reviews.x: I am a hair stylist in the process of locking my hair. This wrap is absolutely perfect! While working through out the day it never once shifted, slid, or became loose. Shampooing, unpacking shipment, mixing colors, cleaning, etc. It stayed in place. The material is soft, flexible, and breathable. I will be buying this again in until I have all of the colors. I have not washed it yet but I have a feeling it will be just fine! Very satisfied.

At first, I thought this is too much to pay for a piece of material but when I got it, I loved it. Its stretchy, soft and it doesn't slide off like some wraps. I can roll it, tuck it and its comfy. I love it.  Its definitely worth it and I will buy more.

reviews.t: Its just black cotton fabric. I could've purchased this ...
reviews.x: Its just black cotton fabric. I could've purchased this as a black scarf from the Dollar Stores. I will use it for its long length.  Way too expensive.
Absolute ripoff for the price.  You get a price of cloth with no directions on how to tie it fancy. Very disappointed.

reviews.t: I wished I could've gotten it black, but I ...
reviews.x: I wished I could've gotten it black, but I had to settle with brown because that was all available. I needed it quickly for a trip that I was going on where I would be sharing a room with other people. So I couldn't wait for black to come available. But I am enjoying my head wrap. I've never been the type to wear head wraps but now that I'm somewhat of a 'naturalista' these days, it has contributed very well to my natural journey. I wear it to sleep, to the grocery store or anywhere when I need

reviews.t: Dress it up or dress it down.
reviews.x: I really like this product. It is super soft and flexible, and can be dressed up or down. I normally where it to the gym and it helps to protect my hair styles (twistout, braidouts. etc) from sweat. The jersey fabric also doesn't dry out your hair like cotton or polyester would. All in all a solid purchase and a staple in my hair accessories. I also love that it is long so I can where it with our without braids.

reviews.t: This wrap is giving me life!
reviews.x: The material is so soft. Wraps my hair so nicely. I will be back for more colors. This natural hair woman is happy! Thank you!
I'm transitioning and this has been a life saver! Love how easy it is to use....strechy. Length is PERFECT!!

reviews.t: Very disappointed. I needed a black head wrap and the ...
reviews.x: Very disappointed. I needed a black head wrap and the one I received was a deep blue. Not black at all.

reviews.t: If I could give no stars I would. First ...
reviews.x: If I could give no stars I would. First of all the color is NOT olive but grey. Second this thing is so see through. The point of a head wrap is to be able to conceal the Ceely braids not show them off. 😳😂. Anywho it is what it is. It’s a bit shorter than I’m used to working with but I’ll have to make it work.
I am disappointed in the appearance of the product I received.

reviews.t: ... a wrap of this nature and I am extremely pleased with my decision to purchase this product
reviews.x: This was my first time attempting to wear a wrap of this nature and I am extremely pleased with my decision to purchase this product. I've already received a second one. I chose the black because I felt I couldn't go wrong with the color. Being inexperienced with the whole prospect I was a little leary as to if I could pull it off. Luckily there are many tutorials on YouTube that gave me the confidence I needed. I've already received my second wrap because I absolutely LOVED everything about thi

I love this head wrap! Its really convenient.. Especially for bad hair days!! After a co wash or a protein treatment, I let my hair air dry, then wrap my hair up and start my day! The wrap came in good packaging. After a couple of washes after my use, the dye colors didnt fade nor shrink in the dryer so that's good! And I got a ton of compliments of me wearing it and where I got it from. I proudly said amazon.

Thank you! I needed a wrap fast but didn't want spend hours searching local fabric stores for the right material..with unfinished edges.  I bought the black one for universal use and it's behaving. The fabric is big enough and has stretch-ability. I'm happy I found you in here and will certainly purchase other color options.

Too small to wrap in styles like the image used with this product. My head is small and my hair is shoulder length. I can only put a knot is the fabric. I was hoping to do more styles due to other reviews stating the fabric was rather large, however it appears that they all aren't the same size. Still lke the fabric though

claims.text: Many reviewers feel the product is overpriced for what is essentially a piece of fabric, often comparing it to cheaper fabric-store material.
Reviewers frequently praise the material as soft and stretchy, which helps with wrapping and styling.
Several customers complain about poor quality, describing the material as thin, lacking stretch, or beading up quickly.
Some reviewers note the lack of instructions or ideas on how to wrap or tie it.
Multiple customers report the wrap stays in place without sliding or coming loose.
